title: AWOL serviceman detained in Odesa after threatening police officers with grenade
summary: A 39-year-old serviceman who had allegedly gone absent without leave (AWOL) threatened police officers with a grenade inside a residential building on Semena Palii Street in Odesa.

title: Nature reserves under tank tracks: HUR details Russian destruction of Ukraine's environment
summary: Russian troops have set up a mortar firing range on the territory of the Pryazovskyi National Nature Park.

title: Russian female soldier involved in assault killed in Pokrovsk sector
summary: Aerial reconnaissance personnel of Ukraine's National Guard Spartan Brigade recorded an adjacent unit killing a Russian infantry soldier in the Pokrovsk sector who, according to the military, turned out to be a woman.
